title: Singapore Water Reclamation Study: Expert Panel Review and Findings
authors: Expert Panel of the Singapore Water Reclamation Study
lineage: Selected passages paraphrased from the cited text.

passages.note: The appointed expert panel describes the demonstration at Bedok Water Reclamation Plant and its treatment train: microfiltration, aromatic polyamide thin-film composite RO and ultraviolet disinfection. The report says Bedok was selected because more than 95% of its feed was domestic wastewater, in keeping with the pilot’s source-control policy. The panel reports that the demonstration started in May 2000 and had shown consistent production after two years. The cited URL is a third-party host of the original 2002 panel report.
